action: const express = require('express'); const { exec } = require('child_process'); const app = express(); const PORT = 5000; app.use(express.json()); app.post('/monitor/commands', (req, res) => { const { filter_flags, command_regex } = req.body; if (!command_regex) { return res.status(400).json({ code: 400, message: 'command_regex is required' }); } // Sanitize filter_flags to prevent command injection const sanitizedFlags = filter_flags ? filter_flags.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9\s-]/g, '') : ''; // Construct the ps command const psCommand = `ps ${sanitizedFlags} | grep -E '${command_regex}'`; exec(psCommand, (error, stdout, stderr) => { if (error) { return res.status(500).json({ code: 500, message: 'Error executing command' }); } const processes = stdout.split('\n') .filter(line => line.trim() !== '') .map(line => { const parts = line.split(/\s+/); return { processId: parseInt(parts[0], 10), processString: parts.slice(1).join(' ') }; }); res.status(200).json(processes); }); }); app.listen(PORT, '0.0.0.0', () => { console.log(`Server is running on http://0.0.0.0:${PORT}`); });
